lanes.name: structural
lanes.detail: row count 2799, header exact, universe bijection, rank permutation of [1, 2799]. Cascade to 0 on any failure.

lanes.name: decile_calibration_tightness
lanes.detail: 20 * max(0, 1 - MAE(bin_mean_realized, bin_expected_center) / MAE_naive) over 10 equal-count bins ordered by agent rank.

lanes.name: cross_sibling_consistency
lanes.detail: 15 * mean(max(0, partial_spearman(agent, sibling_i | prior_year_opmargin_level_rank))) across 4 sibling measures.

cascade: structural or anti-fabrication failure zeros the total, not per-lane deduction.
